The program provides an opportunity to quickly find technical parameters for a certain model of air conditioner or heat pump, both domestic and semi-industrial series. To do this, you need to enter the equipment model or find it using a search engine. Further, you will get access to the technical parameters of the equipment, as well as its appearance - drawings and photographs, which will make it easier to understand how to mount and customize this model.

This application does not request or use any personal information of any users.

And also, it does not use geolocation data either in the active or run in background.
